title: Cursor vs Cline: Which AI Coding Tool Is Right for You in 2026?
summary: Cursor vs Cline compared: proprietary IDE vs open-source VSCode extension. Pricing, features, autonomy levels, and which fits your workflow — plus the full-stack option both miss.
body_markdown: Multiple developers report that Cursor trims context on long sessions — the agent starts "forgetting" earlier decisions as conversations grow beyond a certain size. Cline, using your own API keys, has no economic reason to trim context and sends full reasoning to the model; you can see exactly what it sends in Plan mode. This is the core technical argument for Cline on complex projects.[Blink](https://blink.new/) operates at a higher abstraction level — you issue product-level instructions rather than file-level edits, so context management works differently across the stack.
